summary: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code.
takeaways: We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code.
With our best setting, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation achieves performance competitive with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro across most benchmarks with available comparisons.
Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs.
